biotools.summary: This package provides a flexible representation of copy number, mutation, and other data that fit into the ragged array schema for genomic location data. The basic representation of such data provides a rectangular flat table interface to the user with range information in the rows and samples/specimen in the columns. The RaggedExperiment class derives from a GRangesList representation and provides a semblance of a rectangular dataset.
